easy.def: A sea animal with a rough shell that sometimes holds a pearl.
examples: An oyster lives in the sea.

more.def: A sea animal with a rough, hard shell that sometimes makes a pearl inside.
examples: The diver found an oyster with a pearl in it.
An oyster lives on the sea floor.
The oyster shell was rough and gray.

easy.def: A black and white shore bird with a long red beak.
examples: An oystercatcher walked on the sand.
The oystercatcher has a red beak.

more.def: A black and white shore bird with a long, bright red beak, which it uses to open shellfish.
examples: The oystercatcher pried open a shell with its beak.
An oystercatcher has a bright red beak and loud call.
